༄༅/ /rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyi gdams pa snying po don gsum gyi 'khrid yig nyams len snying po bsdus pa bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyi gdams pa snying po don gsum gyi 'khrid yig nyams len snying po bsdus pa bzhugs/

na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ rgyal kun thugs rje gcig bsdus te/ /spyan ras gzigs zhes rab grags pa/ /gang de'i zhabs la gus btud nas/ /snying po don gsum bshad par bya/ /de yang rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyis grub chen mi tra dzo ki la gnang ba tshe 'di dang 'chi kha dang bar do'i nyams len bya tshul snying po don gsum du grags pa'i gdams pa 'chad pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhi ni 'di ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /kye ma rnyed dka' don chen dal rten 'di/ /'jig par nges shing nam 'chi cha med la/ /shi nas gar skye'i gdengs med ngan 'gro ru/ /skye bar mi 'gyur thabs la 'bad par bya/ /rigs drug gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal las/ /ma 'das de phyir bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun/ /khyad med sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las sgrol phyir/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub dam pa myur thob bya/ /rang gi spyi bor shel dkar las grub pa'i/ /byang chub mchod rten sgo stong ldan pa yi/ /bum pa'i nang du pad dkar zla ba'i steng*/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid dang dbyer med pa'i/ /rnam pa rje btsun 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ /dang po gnyis ni thugs kar thal sbyar zhing*/ /'og ma gnyis kyis shel phreng pad dkar 'dzin/ /dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis rab mdzes shing*/ /rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs sgo stong la/ / bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong rnams bzhugs gyur pa/ /kun kyang rigs lnga'i rnam pa'i bzhugs stangs can/ /lte ba'i phyogs bzhi re rer nyer lnga re/ /'dir spyan ras gzigs kha sar pā ṇi ra bsgoms pa'i lugs snang yang don la khyad med cing*/ yig drug bzla na phyag bzhi pa bde bar bshad pa ltar bkod pa'o/ /de nas/ rang nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang phyag bzhi par/ /gsal ba'i snying rtse gyen du phyogs gyur pa/ /rnam pa pad dmar 'dab ma stong ldan gyi/

/lte bar zla ba'i steng du rang sems dang*/ /dbyer med spyan ras gzigs dbang tshon gang tsam/ /'dab ma rnams la a dkar stong gis brgyan/ /spyi bo'i bla ma snying kha'i rje btsun gyi/ /ral ba'i rtse na rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ /de dag sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyis mtshan/ /thugs kar zla steng hrīḥyig mtha' skor du/ /yig drug chu shel phreng ba lta bus mdzes/ /de las 'od 'phros rang bzhin gnas mchog nas/ /bla ma spyan ras gzigs dbang sangs rgyas stong*/ /mchog gsum rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang*/ /bka' sdod gsang sngags rig sngags tshogs dang bcas/ /spyan drangs dam tshig pa rnams so so la/ /thim pas skyabs gnas kun 'dus bdag nyid gyur/ /de nas yan lag bdun pa bya tshul ni/ 'dod rgu'i dngos grub ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams dang lhag pa'i lha/ /thugs rje chen po sangs rgyas stong la sogs/ /skyabs gnas dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid zhi'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho thams cad dang*/ /bdag lus longs spyod dge tshogs bcas te 'bul/ /rang gzhan kun gyis thog med nas bgyis pa'i/ /sdig ltung nyes tshogs thams cad so sor bshags/ /skye 'phags kun gyis bsags pa'i rnam dkar la/ /bsam pa thag pas rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa legs bskor zhing*/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par bzhugs su gsol/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba ci mchis pa/ /thams cad gcig bsdoms sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ /de nas gsol 'debs ni/ ma lus rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse'i dpung*/ /gcig bsdus spyan ras gzigs zhes mtshan gsol ba/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po thugs rje can/ /zla med skyabs kyi dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /gsal rdzogs mtshan dang dpe byed dpal gyis mdzes/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos phung rab tu sgrogs/ /ji snyed shes bya ma lus kun gzigs pa/ /skal bzang rgyal ba stong la gsol ba 'debs/

/bla ma kun 'dus rje btsun spyan ras gzigs/ /rgyal ba kun 'dus bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong*/ /mchog gsum yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*/ /bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bla ma spyan ras gzigs/ /byin gyis rlobs shig 'phags mchog thugs rje can/ /bdag dang nyam thag 'gro ba thams cad kyang*/ /'jigs rung ngan 'gro'i gnas las skyob tu gsol/ /'di phyi bar do'i 'jigs las=/ mnar gcod sdug bsngal che las= /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtsho las= /dga' ldan chos kyi mdun sar drang du gsol/ /re sa gzhan na med do thugs rjes gzung*/ /da lta nyid du byin gyis rlob tu gsol/ /myur ba nyid du byin gy-is rlob tu gsol/ /thugs rjes gzigs shig lha mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /phyi bshol mi mdzad 'phags pa thugs rje can/ /zhes dad gus drag pos lan gsum mam gcig bya/ ༈ /de ltar gsol bas spyi bo'i bla ma dang*/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku yi cha rnams las/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung rang gi lus kyi char/ /thim pas sdig sgrib kun byang byin gyis brlabs/ /slar yang bdud rtsi'i tshogs byung phyir 'phros te/ /bcud kyi 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib kun sbyangs nas/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang mchog la bkod/ /snod kyi skyon sbyangs dag pa'i zhing du bsgyur/ /rang gzhan kun gyis yi ge drug pa'i sgra/ /'ur 'ur zhes pa'i sgra chen bsgrag par gyur/ /zhes bsams la yig drug ci 'grub bzla'o/ /de nas/ ༈ rang gi snying kha'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros te/ /snod la phog pas 'od du zhu gyur nas/ /bcud rnams spyan ras gzigs su gsal la thim/ /de dag 'od du zhu nas rang nyid dang*/ /spyi bo'i bla ma spyan ras gzigs zhu nas/ /rang gi snying kha'i spyan ras gzigs la thim/ /sangs rgyas stong yang snying kha'i hrīḥl thim/ /mchod rten nam mkhar 'ja' ltar yal ba dang*/ /rang nyid snying kha'i spyan ras gzigs la thim/

/de yang thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim par gyur/ /hrīḥyig rim gyis 'ja' ltar dag gyur te/ /stong pa nyid kyi ngang du zhugs pa las/ /slar yang spyan ras gzigs kyi sku ru gyur/ /rang sems bla ma yi dam dbyair med dang*/ /gang snang lhar gsal sku yi 'khyer so dang*/ /sgra grags snang ba gsung gi 'khyer so dang*/ /chos kun bden stong thugs kyi 'khyer so ste/ /nyams len snying po 'khyer so gsum ldan gyur/ /'dir yang yig drug ci 'grub bzla'o/ /de nas rang sems skye med bsgom tshul ni/ rang sems la sogs 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /ming brdas bzhag pa tsam zhig ma gtogs par/ /ngo bos grub pa rdul tsam med pas na/ /stong sang spros bral nam mkha' lta bur gyur/ /dmigs med stong pa'i ngang nas rjes thob tu/ /snang ba gang shar sgyu ma rmi lam dang*/ /chu nang zla ba mig 'phrul chur snang ba'i/ /snang stong 'gal med ngang du 'jug par gyur/ /zhes pa ni tshe 'di'i nyams len gyi skor ro/ /gnyis pa 'chi kha'i gdams ngag gi snying po nyams su len pa la gnyis las/ dang po mchod sbyin tshogs gsog ji ltar bya ba ni/ rang nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang phyag bzhi bar/ /gsal ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar sed+ge'i khrir/ /pad zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/ /dbyer med rje btsun 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ /rtsa phyag thal sbyar lhag ma g.yas g.yon gyis/ /shel phreng pad dkar 'dzin cing mtshan dpes spras/ /rin chen dar gyi na bza' gsol bas mdzes/ /'od kyi phung po'i dbus na pad zhabs zung*/ /rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs mtha' skong du/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang*/ /sangs rgyas byang sems zhi khro nyan rang 'phags/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bstan srung tshogs rnams kyis/ /bskor nas bzhugs pa'i khri 'og khri zung sogs/ /mtha' skor gdon bgegs lan chags mgron rnams dang*/

/rigs drug 'gro ba yongs kyis bskor bar gyur/ /de nas lus kyi mchod sbyin gyi tshogs gsog bya tshul ni/ thog med nas bzung da lta'i bar dag tu/ /mchog dman lus ni grangs med blangs gyur kyang*/ /rang nyid gces 'dzin goms pa'i dbang gyur te/ /lus la snying po len pa ma byung bas/ /da res lus 'dir snying po blang bar bya/ /rang sems spyan ras gzigs dbang tshon gang tsam/ /snying ga nas thon nam mkhar gnas gyur pa'i/ /spyan ras gzigs des phung po rnying ba la/ /bltas pas mdzes tsho yid 'ong snum bag can/ /zhig tu 'dug par mthong nas mdun ngos kyi/ /bla ma spyan ras gzigs sogs skyabs kun la/ /lus 'di 'bul lo bzhes nas dngos grub stsol/ /ces zhus dus bla ma'i zhal nas oṃ āḥhūṃ/ /gsungs pas mi mgo'i sgyed pu ri rab tsam/ /gsum du gyur pa mdun du gnas pa na/ /rang sems bla ma lha yi thugs ka nas/ /mkha' 'gro gri gug thogs pa zhig byung ste/ /rang lus rnying ba'i smin mtshams yan chad kyi/ /thod pa ling gis bkog nas sgyed pu'i steng*/ /bzhag pas stong gsum khyon dang mnyam par gyur/ /slar yang gri gug thogs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /du ma spros te rang lus phung rnying gi /sha rus dum bur btub nas thod par blugs/ /thod pa sha khrag gis gang bla ma lhas/ /slar yang oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes gsungs pas/ /sha khrag rus gsum thams cad zag med kyi/ /bdud rtsi'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ /slar yang rang sems lha yi thugs ka nas/ /mkha' 'gro thod pa thogs pa dpag med zhig /spros te thod pa'i bdud rtsi lum bcus nas/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mchog gsum dang*/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs la phul byas pas/ /zag med bde bas tshim zhing dgyes par gyur/ /de bzhin gnod byed gdon bgegs lan chags kyi/ /mgron la byin pas lan chags sha 'khon byang*/ /bu lon byang nas spyan ras gzigs su

gyur/ /de nas mar gyur rigs drug mgron rnams la/ /sngar bzhin byin pas rigs drug sdug bsngal dang*/ /sdig sgrib byang ste snod kun dag zhing dang*/ / bcud kyi sems can spyan ras gzigs su gyur/ /ces brjod cing 'dir yang yig brgya bzla'o/ /mthar/ tshogs zhing bcas pa'i snod bcud thams cad kyang*/ /'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa na/ /rang yang mi dmigs stong pa nyid du gyur/ /chos kun rang bzhin stong gsal nam mkha'i ngang*/ /slar yang rang nyid spyan ras gzigs gyur te/ /mar gyur 'gro ba'i don la rjes su dgongs/ /༈ gnyis pa 'pho ba'i man ngag ni/ skyabs 'gro sogs byas te/ rang lus nang dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma/ /sba lcag tsam zhig yar sna tshangs bug dang*/ /mar sna lte 'og zug pa'i snying dbus su/ /rang sems spyan ras gzigs dbang sku mdog dkar/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi thal sbyar shel phreng dang*/ /pad dkar 'dzin cing rgyan dang na bzas mdzes/ /'od dkyil dbus su skyil krung gis gzhugs gyur/ /steng phyogs dga' ldan chos kyi pho brang na/ /byams mgon gser mdog bzang po'i bzhugs stangs tshul/ /mtshan dpe'i 'od 'bar chos 'khor phyag rgya can/ /dgyes pa'i thugs kyis dgongs shing gzigs par gyur/ /skyon bral yon tan kun gyi gter gyur pa/ /mgon med nyam thag 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs/ /thub pa'i rgyal tshab mi pham chos kyi rje/ /gsol ba 'debs so byams mgon thugs rje can/ /mnar gcod sdug bsngal mtha' dag zhi bar mdzod/ /'jigs rung bar do'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol/ /ngan song 'khor ba'i 'jigs las skyob tu gsol/ /shi 'phos dga' ldan gnas su drang du gsol/ /byin gyis rlobs shig byams mgon thugs rje'i gter/ /thugs rjes gzigs shig byams brtse'i bdag nyid can/ /da lta nyid du khyod kyi drung der drongs/ /skyon bral zhes pa man gyi gsol 'debs lan gsum mam bdun sogs bya'o/

༈ /de ltar gsol bas rje btsun thugs ka nas/ /'od kyi sbu gu rgyangs kyis byung nas ni/ /bdag gi spyi bor tshangs bug mtha' skor zug / slar yang 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu zhig /'od kyi sbu gu'i nang brgyud rang gi sems/ /spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba'i thor cog rtser/ /btab drangs skar mda' 'phangs bzhin rje btsun gyi/ /thugs kar thim zhing slar thon pad+ma'i dbus/ /rdzus skyes byams pa'i sras kyi mchog gyur nas/ /byang chub lung bstan dam pa thob par shog /zhes pa ni 'chi kha'i dus kyi nyams len no/ /༈ gsum pa bar do'i nyams len ni/ de ltar 'bad kyang dngos su 'pho bar ma nus na ji ltar bya ba ni/ ༈ /gal te byams pa'i drung du 'dod pa bzhin/ /dngos su 'pho bar ma nus las nyon gyis/ /bar do grub par gyur na de yi tshe/ /phyi nang gsang bar bsgyur ba'i man ngag gis/ /dga' ldan gnas sam bde ba can la sogs/ /rnam dag zhing du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /phyi bsgyur da lta snang ba gang shar yang*/ /bar do'i 'khrul pa'i snang ba nyid yin zhes/ /rgyun chags dran pa'i nyams len goms byas te/ /da bzod bar do'i snang ba dngos shar tshe/ /'khrul snang rnams la de ru ngo shes shing*/ /nang bsgyur bcud kyi snang ba gang shar ba/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi sku yi rnam pa dang*/ /snod rnams dag pa'i zhing du blta zhing dran/ /gsang bsgyur gang shar 'khrul snang tsam nyid las/ /ma 'das rang bzhin med pa'i stong nyid du/ /legs par blta ba'i phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /nyams len tshul la legs par goms byas te/ /bden stong sgyu ma lta bu'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /dman pa'i skye sgo bkag nas dga' bzhin du/ /gzhan don rgya chen 'grub pa'i rten bzang po/ /bsams bzhin nying mtshams sbyor ba'i mthu thob shog /dag pa'i zhing du skyes nas snying rje yis/ /ma dag zhing gi 'gro ba 'dren pa la/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyi spyod pa ltar/

/legs par spyad nas myur du 'tshang rgya shog /ces bya'o/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi gdams pa snying po don gsum 'di la rgyal dbang dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i rgyas pa zhig snang yang lag len dka' zhing*/ paṇa chen gong mas mdzad pa'i 'bring po zhig snang ba la mchod sbyin gyi skor sogs 'ga' zhig ni shin tu bsdus 'dug pas/ 'dir co ne'i khri zur bshad sgrub ming can gyis rnam pa gnyis ka'i bzhed pa dang bstun nas ji ltar 'tsham par go bde zhing 'jug pa bde ched tshigs bcad du byas te dad pas sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni tā yi la lung blo bzang don grub bo/ //maṅga laṃ/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyi gdams pa snying po don gsum gyi 'khrid yig nyams len snying po bzhugs/ -PAGE 58--PAGE 65--PAGE 57-
